settings.heading: A place to gather, built here in Nebraska.
settings.text: A place where modern medicine and ancient practices meet, with a movement studio, a café, a greenhouse, and room to gather. You come because you want to be there. I'm building it in public, one chapter at a time.

settings.heading: What I'm building
settings.intro: A place you come because you want to be there, not because something is wrong. Providers who listen, a space that feels special, and people to share it with.
settings.statement: Maybe you feel fine and want to feel better. Maybe it's a special day. Maybe something feels off. Either way, you're not broken. Sometimes things need adjusting, and we're here to listen.

settings.title: Providers who listen
settings.text: Modern medicine and ancient practices under one roof. A primary or functional medicine provider, an herbalist, a reiki practitioner, each there to listen and support you.

settings.title: A movement studio
settings.text: A beautiful room you'll want to come back to.

settings.title: Recovery
settings.text: A sauna and quiet spaces where you get to rest for a while.

settings.title: The café
settings.text: Somewhere to sit with friends where you don't have to put on a show. You just show up as who you are.

settings.title: Greenhouse and farm
settings.text: Learn about plants and where food comes from. Pick fruits and vegetables, and taste them in what we serve.

settings.title: Stay the night
settings.text: When you want to settle in longer, there will be room to stay.

settings.quote: "It was simply sitting together, journaling, and listening to one another. The magic that comes from that community is life changing."
settings.context: This is the feeling I want the club to hold, every day of the week.
